title: Connected components of hammocks give ordinary localization
statement:
Let $C$ be a small category and $W$ a wide subcategory. Use the reduced-hammock simplicial category $H(C,W)$ of [lem-coef-hammock-graph-colimit-presentation]. Let $C[W^{-1}]$ be the category with the same objects obtained by adjoining formal inverses to every arrow of $W$, subject to composition and inverse relations. Multiplying any row of a hammock in this ordinary localization, inverting the leftward arrows, induces a bijection
$$\pi_0 H(C,W)(x,y)\ \cong\ C[W^{-1}](x,y)$$
for all $x,y$. These bijections preserve identities and composition and are natural under functors of pairs. No freeness, calculus of fractions, or model-category structure is assumed.

source.place: Dwyer–Kan, Calculating simplicial localizations, Proposition 3.1, printed p.20. No Stacks tag states this result.
